title: Mathematics
tagline: Proofs you can enjoy: numbers, the infinite, shape and symmetry.
intro: Mathematics for its own sake, beside the probability course and the math toolkit for machine learning. It starts with practice: a ladder of four levels from school problems to olympiad problems, then three topic sets of classic results, each with a hint and a full proof. Every solution is written so you can learn the method from it. Lessons will follow.

1.title: The ladder
1.blurb: Four levels of problems, from basics through intermediate and advanced to olympiad. Climb in order.
